verdict.rationale: Godot is a programmable tool, so asking about autonomous background automation is a fair question. The evidence shows no first-party scheduler, trigger, or background-automation feature. The headless CLI mode and EditorScript are developer building blocks: EditorScript is a one-off action run manually from the editor, not a recurring autonomous job, and any scheduling would require external CI or cron arranged by the user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
